analysis.preflight_limit: Harness retained planner success only, not numeric planner capacity; completed full-budget generation is the admission evidence.
analysis.scope: One whole-book performance case; no automatic promotion, new practical gain gate, benchmark quality score, or general model qualification.

configuration.comparison_policy: pairs before1/candidate2 and before4/candidate3 by repetition; report prefill, decode and wall separately; require same seeded outputs and MTP work for scheduling attribution; retain modest gains as evidence
configuration.host_policy: all observations retained under current load; no quiet gate, cooling, retries or exclusions
configuration.identity_policy: guard once before run and after every session; separate worker executable hashes checked before each load
configuration.privacy: dataset and rendered input/output/token arrays held only in memory; persist hashes,counts,timings and fixed categories only
configuration.promotion_policy: no automatic promotion from a single public case; prior practical criteria and full correctness/lifecycle qualification remain separate
configuration.selection_policy: one pinned public whole-book record; unmodified official prompt; task/performance case only, not full InfiniteBench score

source.selection: first original-order whole record with 65536..131072 native rendered tokens; no padding/truncation or performance-based selection

configuration.warmup_policy: one same-book full-context request per worker,64 output tokens; excluded only as preregistered warmup

prior_experiment.component_control: Historical unchanged-build control: 60 cases, 9375336 bytes, zero unequal bytes. Not rerun or broadened.

privacy: Only hashes,counts,timings,fixed metadata and original harness source are published. Corpus/rendered inputs/outputs/vectors/probabilities never persisted.
promotion: Additional evidence only; source remains experimental, production default unchanged; not installed/released.
scope: One unmodified public whole-book performance case, not an official InfiniteBench suite or quality score.
